metric: Covered U.S. goods and services exports to China against Phase One commitments
finding: Purchases fell materially short of agreement commitments; does not by itself establish an attributable net U.S. geopolitical loss or equivalent Chinese gain.
limitations: Measured trade values are not company profits, tax receipts or national economic benefits.
COVID-19, tariffs, prices, supplier diversification and export capacity complicate attribution.
PIIE publication versions differ slightly due to services revisions; use cited current webpage vintage for this measurement.
Covered goods and services only; do not compare to total bilateral exports or Chinese customs goods imports.
